name: OU & GPO Enumeration (PowerView)
description: Map Organizational Units and the GPOs linked to them to find delegation and misconfigured policy that can be abused. PowerView resolves OU->gplink->GPO so you can see which computers a policy applies to and which GPO grants a foothold (e.g. a Restricted Group or a scheduled task).

variations.label: GPO linked to an OU (resolve gplink)
Where a user/group is local admin via GPO
gpresult /r - applied GPOs on this host

steps.label: See which GPO is linked to the OU
Find who can edit GPOs (abuse path)

notes: OU/GPO mapping is the recon step before GPO abuse: find an OU you can influence, the GPO linked to it, and the computers in scope. gpcfilesyspath points to the SYSVOL folder holding the policy files. Follow with crtp-gpo-abuse to weaponize write access to a linked GPO.

recommended.note: Find who has write rights over the GPO/OU
Weaponize write access to a linked GPO

defense.prerequisites: Any authenticated domain user (OU/GPO objects and gplink attributes are world-readable in AD).
defense.why_it_works: OU structure, GPO objects, and gplink relationships are stored as readable directory attributes; combined with default DACL readability, any user can reconstruct which policies apply where and which principals can edit them.
defense.misconfiguration: Non-privileged principals granted Write/WriteDacl on GPO objects or link permissions on OUs; overly broad delegation; SYSVOL policy paths readable/writable beyond admins.
defense.impact: Reveals GPO-based privilege-escalation and lateral-movement paths (editable GPO linked to servers/DCs) - the map for a domain-wide compromise via GPO abuse.
defense.detection: LDAP queries enumerating groupPolicyContainer and organizationalUnit objects with gplink; unusual read volume against the Policies container; BloodHound-style collection patterns.
defense.artifacts: Directory service access logs (4662) for GPO/OU objects; SYSVOL access spikes.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Non-admins with WriteProperty/WriteDacl on GPO objects
# OU delegation granting link/edit to helpdesk or app teams
defense.secure_config:
# Restrict GPO edit rights to a small admin group; audit GPO DACLs
# Remove unnecessary OU delegation; monitor gplink changes
# Enable AD object-access auditing (4662) on Policies container
defense.prevention: Audit and minimize GPO/OU delegation; restrict WriteDacl/WriteProperty on GPOs to admins; monitor GPO/gplink changes and SYSVOL edits. [MITRE M1018, M1026]
defense.evasion: Read-only LDAP enumeration blends with normal management traffic; scope queries to a single OU to reduce volume.
